analogy.rationale: ATM inhibitors block the DNA damage response kinase, so CHK inhibitors (downstream checkpoint kinases) and other DNA damage-response or DNA-replication-targeting classes should yield the most similar transcriptional profiles. General kinase inhibitors are less specific but may partially overlap.
